title: a v1-abi-conformance report, format 1
description: What one (binding, toolchain, os) leg of the v1-abi-conformance job uploads after running every case in tests/fixtures/abi-v1/cases.json through its generated invoke-by-name dispatcher and loader against the stub libraries. scripts/abi-v1/parity.py reads these (never committed; downloaded as CI artifacts) to decide whether every enrolled binding passes every case, with no leg missing, stale, failed or carrying a case the current cases.json does not describe.

cases_sha256.description: sha256 of the sorted, compact JSON of cases.json's own "cases" array (scripts/abi-v1/parity.py's compute_cases_hash), so a report generated against an older cases.json is detected as STALE rather than silently compared against the wrong set.
